title: LEMON-CAKE
ingredients: 1 cup of butter (packed). 2 scant cups of sugar.  10 eggs, yolks and whites beaten separately.  1 small cup of milk.   Juice and rind of a lemon.  1 small teaspoonful soda.   Flour to make tolerably thin batter (between two and three cups). Of some qualities of flour three cups will be needed.
